\subsection*{Gaussian Space --- Borell --- Affine: Results}

\begin{theorem}[Affine Gaussian noise stability]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianNoiseStability_affine}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianNoiseStability_affine}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianNoise, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianNoiseStability, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianNoise_add, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianNoise_const_mul, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianNoise_memLp, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.integral_gaussianNoise}
\difficulty{4}
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$
belong to $L^2$ under the product standard Gaussian measure. For all $a,b\in\mathbb R$,
the Gaussian noise stability of $x\mapsto af(x)+b$ is $a^2$ times the stability of $f$,
plus $2ab$ times the Gaussian mean of $f$, plus $b^2$.
\end{theorem}
